agents.name: Literature Researcher
agents.description: [Run] Verifikasi referensi di references.bib, resources/ dan paper/ lewat web, cek celah riset terhadap arXiv:2606.20023 dan paper multibahasa lain. Serahkan: tugas sitasi, kebaruan, dan riset judul.

agents.name: Results Analyst
agents.description: [Build] Hitung ulang OPR/TCR/PER dari results/*.json|csv dan dataset/, bandingkan dengan abstrak, README, tabel LaTeX, tambah confidence interval. Serahkan: tugas angka, benchmark, statistik.

agents.name: Paper Writer
agents.description: [Make] Tulis ulang abstrak dan klaim di paper/*.tex, README.md, title_list.md agar sesuai hasil nyata; susun judul NUS dan TA. Serahkan: tugas tulisan dan judul.

agents.name: Integrity Reviewer
agents.description: [Build] Review src/, scripts/, tests/ untuk konsistensi klaim vs kode: verifier, execution_backend simulated, klaim latensi. Serahkan: tugas review kode dan integritas klaim.

summaries.dispatching-parallel-agents: Use when facing 2+ independent tasks that can be worked on without shared state or sequential dependencies
summaries.verification-before-completion: Use when about to claim work is complete, fixed, or passing, before committing or creating PRs - requires running verification commands and confirming output b…
summaries.research: Investigate a question against high-trust primary sources and capture the findings as a Markdown file in the repo.
summaries.statistical-analysis: Apply statistical methods including descriptive stats, trend analysis, outlier detection, and hypothesis testing.
summaries.validate-data: QA an analysis before sharing -- methodology, accuracy, and bias checks.
summaries.writing-guidelines: Review docs/prose for Writing Guidelines compliance.
summaries.ponytail-review: Quality review of a change: is the logic right, is it safe, does it hold under real load, is risky code tested, is it fast enough, and is every line needed.
summaries.security-audit: Security guidance and vulnerability review for codebases, APIs, services, CLI tools, libraries, and daemons.
